meta.name: talking-head-recut
meta.description: Package an existing talking-head / interview / podcast video with timed, designed GRAPHIC OVERLAY cards — kinetic titles, lower-thirds, data callouts, quotes, side panels, picture-in-picture — synced to the transcript, on a 16:9 / 9:16 / 4:5 canvas of your choice; the clip plays untouched underneath. Trigger on "graphic overlays", "on-screen graphics", "package / dress up my video". Not plain subtitles (/embedded-captions). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 给访谈播客视频配上时间同步的图形卡片，让画面更生动
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你有采访或播客视频,想加标题和重点提示又不重剪
copy.tagline_en: Add timed graphic cards to talking-head videos for a polished, lively look
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have interview or podcast footage and want to add graphics without re-editing

howto.what: 拿一段已有视频(如访谈、播客),在画面上按时间叠放设计好的图形卡片——标题、字幕条、数据标注、引语、侧面板、画中画等,卡片内容与说话内容同步;原视频从头到尾保持完整,最终合成渲染成 MP4 文件。
howto.when: 当你说 “graphic overlays”“on-screen graphics”,或要给已有视频“包装、打扮”时触发;纯字幕需求不归它管,不确定的意图先经 /hyperframes 判定。

say.text: 给这段访谈视频加上标题条、下三分之一等图形卡片,按说话内容对齐时间。
say.note: Claude 会转录视频、设计卡片并渲染出带图形的 MP4。

say.text: 把这段播客视频包装成竖版 9:16,配上数据标注和引语卡。
say.note: 会按竖屏画布合成并导出 MP4。

say.text: 在这个视频上加画中画和侧边卡片,风格走 noir。
say.note: 会照指定风格生成卡片再渲染。

howto.what_en: Adds designed graphic cards (titles, lower-thirds, data, quotes, side panels, PiP) over an existing talking-head video, synced to speech. HTML is authored in chat, then assembled and rendered to MP4 via hyperframes. Original clip untouched.
howto.when_en: Triggered by "graphic overlays", "on-screen graphics", or packaging/dressing up a video. For talking-head/interview/podcast clips — not plain subtitles; unclear intent goes to /hyperframes.

say_en.text: Add cards (titles, lower-thirds) to this interview video, synced to the speech.
say_en.note: Claude will transcribe, design cards, and render an MP4.

say_en.text: Package this podcast video as vertical 9:16, with data callouts and quote cards.
say_en.note: It will compose on a vertical canvas and export MP4.

say_en.text: Add picture-in-picture and side-panel cards to this video, noir style.
say_en.note: Cards will be generated in that style and rendered.
